newsitem.title: USA: Transitional Hospitals accepts Vencor offer.
newsitem.headline: Transitional Hospitals accepts Vencor offer.

text.p: Transitional Hospitals Corp said Thursday it had accepted a $639 million cash takeover offer from Vencor Inc..

Transitional, whose shareholders will receive $16 per share under a definitive agreement with Vencor, said the deal spells the end of a previous agreement to be acquired by privately-held Select Medical Corp for $14.55 per share.
Transitional announced on May 4 that it had accepted Select Medical's merger offer. Within a week, Vencor launched a competing bid and a cash tender offer for Transitional shares.
In a statement issued jointly with Vencor today, Transitional said its board had recommended that shareholders accept Vencor's $16-per-share bid.
Vencor's tender offer for Transitional shares is scheduled to expire tonight, but it has been extended repeatedly in the past.
After completion of the tender offer, Vencor said all remaining Transitional shares will be converted into $16 cash per share.
